metadata.dataset: NCT gazetteer — search index of named things on the North Country Trail (NCTA points, state mile markers, chapter boundaries, termini)

inputs.chapter_extents: ncta-chapter-extents-2026-11-23.md (names only; coordinates/chainages from the centerline)

metadata.chainage_method: Greedy endpoint walk of the centerline from the western terminus (150 m join tolerance); chainage = stored segment miles before the point plus its fraction along its segment, plus straight-line miles for any unmapped gap the walk jumped. Points more than 250 m from the main chain get chainage null (off_chain=true) rather than a fabricated position.

terminal_break.note: The walk ends here (eastern terminus reached); the jump is NOT counted in the gap miles above.

metadata.name_rule: A waypoint with no name in the NCTA service takes its kind as its name, with named=false.
